title: 第一卷 第1章 重回一九八八！
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“吃吃，耀宗，吃饱饱！”

闫耀宗只感觉一团黏黏糊糊的东西塞进嘴里，让他差点呛到。

狠狠地摇晃晕乎乎的脑袋，闫耀宗慢慢地睁开眼。

定眼看去，一个被雨水泡得发胀的馒头。

闫耀宗表情错愕，顺着捏着发胀泡烂馒头的右手，看向缩在自己怀里的娇小身影。

闫耀宗瞪大眼睛，涌动着难以置信。

我、我这是重生了？

看着那张沾着泥水跟头发的面容，闫耀宗呼吸都急促了起来。

缩在闫耀宗怀里的傻婆娘，脸上洋溢着憨憨的笑容，脸颊上两个小梨涡格外明显，“吃，耀宗饿了，吃馒头！吃了馒头，不打媳妇。”

闫耀宗抬手狠狠地给了自己一耳光。

疼，真疼！

不是做梦。

自己真的重生了。

忽然，闫耀宗脸色骤变，抓起傻婆娘手里边被雨水泡透的馒头，豁然起身，狠狠地向着窗外丢去。

也就在这时候，紧闭的屋门被人一脚踹开。

只见刘翠花跟闫耀祖披着蓑衣，戴着雨帽，气势汹汹地冲进屋。

刘翠花狠狠地瞪了一眼抱住闫耀宗大腿的傻婆娘，旋即扫视屋内，空气中弥漫的霉臭，让她忍不住皱起眉。

站在刘翠花旁边的闫耀祖面露烦躁，看向闫耀宗，质问道，“你俩是不是去厨房偷馒头了？”

“没有！”闫耀宗冷声道。

“没有？”

刘翠花的情绪瞬间激动了起来，指着闫耀宗的鼻子，骂道，“你个养不熟的白眼狼，真当老娘是瞎子啊？厨房里边还留着这傻婆娘的脚印。还有，院门锁着呢，除了你们，还能有谁？”

“闫耀宗，老娘告诉你，赶紧把馒头拿出来。你要

听着刘翠花的咒骂，闫耀宗怀疑自己到底是不是她亲生的。

就算是偏心，也没这么偏的。

脑海中闪过前世的记忆。

一九八八年，七月。

云海市整整下了两个多月的暴雨。

Page (1/3)

"Eat, Yaozong, eat until you're full!"

Yan Yaozong only felt a lump of sticky stuff stuffed into his mouth, which made him almost choke.

Shaking his dizzy head vigorously, Yan Yaozong slowly opened his eyes.

Looking closely, he saw a steamed bun that was swollen from the rain.

Yan Yaozong looked stunned, looking at the petite figure huddled in his arms along his right hand holding the swollen and soaked buns.

Yan Yaozong's eyes widened with disbelief.

I, am I reborn?

Looking at the face with muddy water and hair, Yan Yaozong's breathing quickened.

The silly woman huddled in Yan Yaozong's arms, with a naive smile on her face, and the two small pear dimples on her cheeks were particularly obvious, "Eat, Yaozong is hungry, eat steamed buns! If you eat steamed buns, don't beat your wife."

Yan Yaozong raised his hand and slapped himself hard.

It hurts, it really hurts!

Not a dream.

I was truly reborn.

Suddenly, Yan Yaozong's expression suddenly changed, he grabbed the rain-soaked steamed bun in the silly woman's hand, stood up suddenly, and threw it out the window.

At this moment, the closed door was kicked open.

Liu Cuihua and Yan Yaozu were seen rushing into the house menacingly, wearing raincoats and rain hats.

Liu Cuihua glared at the silly woman hugging Yan Yaozong's thigh, and then glanced around the room. The musty smell in the air made her frown.

Yan Yaozu, who was standing next to Liu Cuihua, looked irritated. He looked at Yan Yaozong and asked, "Did you two go to the kitchen to steal steamed buns?"

"No!" Yan Yaozong said coldly.

"No?"

Liu Cuihua's mood suddenly became excited. She pointed at Yan Yaozong's nose and cursed, "You immature white-eyed wolf, do you really think that I am blind? There are still the footprints of this stupid woman in the kitchen. Also, the courtyard door is locked. Who else can be there besides you?"

Listening to Liu Cuihua's curses, Yan Yaozong doubted whether he was her biological child.

Even if it's biased, it's not that biased.

Memories of past lives flashed through my mind.

July 1988.

It rained heavily in Yunhai City for more than two months.
